Trinamool Congress Leader Resigns Amidst Party Internal Strife

Senior Trinamool Congress leader Chandrima Bhattacharya has resigned from all party posts, citing a loss of confidence from party chief Mamata Banerjee. This resignation comes amidst internal party conflict, with a rebel faction reportedly meeting the Election Commission to stake a claim on the party's name and symbol. The developments represent a significant internal challenge for the TMC.
